facts.fact: 红皮卡停下时，那辆车还在烧。
facts.anchor: THE car was still on fire when the red pickup pulled up.

facts.fact: 前座上的司机头被打掉了。
facts.anchor: The driver had his head blown off in the front seat.

facts.fact: 琼说押运车上运的不是西德妮·克拉克。
facts.anchor: They were not transporting Sydney Clarke.

facts.fact: 维克多说这意思是西德妮把她带回来了。
facts.anchor: Which means Sydney must have brought her back.

facts.fact: 琼蹲在最近的尸体旁，从死特工腰带上摘武器。
facts.anchor: June crouched over the nearest corpse, plucking weapons from the dead agent’s belt like a magpie picking over shiny tokens.

facts.fact: 维克多站在二十码外，穿黑大衣，比两人上次碰面时大了三岁。
facts.anchor: Victor, standing right there, twenty yards away, pale and tall in his black coat, three years older than he’d been the last time they crossed paths.

facts.fact: 维克多看见伊莱，却没有动作。
facts.anchor: Victor saw him. And did nothing.
